method_notes: Read only small JSON artifacts and nnU-Net text log; no model, checkpoint, or image read.
Partial epoch currently executing is not included in historical completed epoch sums.
Summed model seconds are allocated job time, not campaign wall time because jobs run concurrently.
epoch_training_seconds includes batch fetching, training operations, per-step sync and progress JSON writes.
epoch_validation_seconds includes complete serial CPU and GPU validation pipeline, not just GPU time.
Timer is recorded before each epoch checkpoint save; unclassified wall includes previous checkpoint saves, metrics output and small scheduling overhead.
Current campaign state.stage takes precedence over stale progress_snapshot.phase.
Final evaluation derived from preceding predict completion includes orchestration/import overhead.

models.nnunet_epoch_timing_scope: nnU-Net text reports aggregate patch training plus patch validation epoch time; cannot separate the two from this log.

host_sample.scope: 61 one-second GPU samples; campaign stage every5samples; arithmetic sampled average, not end-to-end campaign utilization

cpu_profile.scope: Two sequential CPU-only preprocess calls, same median native-voxel-count TRAIN CT; cProfile overhead included; filesystem page cache uncontrolled. Synthetic zero probabilities for geometry-only backprojection benchmark; no accuracy conclusions.
cpu_profile.train_case_selection: median native voxel count among197 frozen train cases

inference_work_geometry.note: Derived from production tiling loops; no model or GPU inference run.

synthetic_backprojection.input: Three zero-valued float32 channels with real CT processed/native geometry; not model predictions

argmax_candidate.scope: CPU-only synthetic finite float32 arrays at median native CT dimensions. No model predictions, CT payloads, masks, or labels loaded. Not real-model validation. Three alternating-order repetitions, no discarded warmups; first-use allocation effects included.
argmax_candidate.input: Three independent uniform[0,1) channels plus explicit ties. Values are not normalized probabilities; argmax equivalence only depends on their order.
argmax_candidate.precondition: Exactly three finite same-shape float32 channels. NaN behavior is not supported by this candidate. Production upstream finite checks must remain.

finite_precheck.reason: Neither current production argmax nor candidate itself validates finite values; upstream inference does.

argmax_candidate.timing_scope: Includes full output allocation; original includes stack, argmax int64 output and uint8 cast; pairwise includes uint8 prediction and comparison temporaries. Excludes generating/checking inputs and validating output equality.

method_notes_scope: Existing epoch/stage accounting only; CPU preprocessing separately reads one training CT.
